en.title: Longest Subsequence of X That Is a Substring of Y
en.description:
Find the longest string s that is both a subsequence of X and a contiguous substring of Y, and return its length. The original text of this entry has only a title, function name, and examples; it was cross-checked against the full statement of salesforce-longest-subsequence-which-is-a-substring from the same snapshot. When there is no match, the length is 0.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: Two lines, X and Y respectively. The source gives no size or alphabet range; on this site both are non-empty lowercase strings of length 1..2000.
en.explanation: The answers are 7, 3, and 0; in the second example, abd is a subsequence of X and a contiguous substring of Y.
hints: Update dp[j] row by row over the characters of X: within the processed prefix of X, dp[j] is the maximum length of a contiguous piece ending at the j-th character of Y that can be formed. When the characters are equal, transition from the old dp[j−1]+1; otherwise, the only option is to skip the current character of X.
